name: Norwegian Avalanche Warning Service (varsom.no API)
short: Daily avalanche danger levels per Norwegian warning region; free, keyless JSON.
summary: The Norwegian Avalanche Warning Service, run by NVE, publishes daily avalanche warnings through a REST API: danger level, valid period, next warning time and main text for each warning region. JSON or XML by Accept header. No key is needed.

tasks: avalanche danger level in a Norwegian region today
warnings for a region and date range

pricing.notes: API docs page: the data is freely available. No fee or key is mentioned.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: warnings carry PublishTime and NextWarningTime (17:00 the day before); in early November the regions checked returned danger level 0 with text 'Ikke vurdert' (not assessed).

delivery.basis: Live check 2026-11-08: warnings carry PublishTime and NextWarningTime (17:00 the day before); in early November the regions checked returned danger level 0 with text 'Ikke vurdert' (not assessed).

coverage.notes: Warning regions such as Trollheimen (3022), Svalbard east (3001) and Svalbard west (3002). Off-season regions show not assessed.

licensing.summary: API docs page (Norwegian): the data is freely available for use; a warning is not complete unless all its data is shown, and the source is to be named 'Varsler fra Snoskredvarslingen i Norge og www.varsom.no'. AI training and resale are not mentioned.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: Warnings for one region; langKey 1 is Norwegian; dates YYYY-MM-DD.
All regions with their warnings for the dates.

api.notes: Swagger docs are linked from the docs page. The Accept header selects JSON or XML.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each warning has valid-from, valid-to and publish times; they are the service's own.

location.unknown: Warnings are forecasts for a region, not measurements at a point.

content.unknown: Warnings are the forecasters' judgement; no check against observed avalanches is described here.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.

sources.claim: Docs: freely available data, source naming, REST JSON/XML
